descriptionText:
Note: The job is a remote job and is open to candidates in USA. Pontosense is hiring a Junior Solutions Engineer to serve as a technical partner for key accounts and major customer deployments. The role onboards agencies, manages platform integrations, coordinates technical support for large customers, and relays field feedback to product and engineering.
Responsibilities
Technical onboarding. Agencies and partners get set up on our platform, trained and live, with their first sensors in homes
Integrations. APIs and data flows between our platform and our largest technology and care partners, built, tested and kept running
Key accounts. Day-to-day technical coordination with our largest customers, and support on the deals that grow them
Deployment know-how. Guides, checklists and answers, so the next rollout goes faster than the last
Product feedback. What customers need goes back to product and engineering, with the detail they need to act on it
Skills
You would rather own a problem than be assigned a task
The mission matters to you and the pace feels real, not stressful
You are the person who just fixes it
Benefits
A sensor for your parents, on us
Direct access to the leadership team. No layers.
Hybrid in Toronto or Waterloo, remote if that's where you do your best work
Health, dental and vision benefits
Company Overview
Privacy-first sensing platform powering contactless safety and health intelligence across home care and smart environments. It was founded in 2021, and is headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, CAN, with a workforce of 51-200 employees. Its website is https://www.pontosense.com/.
